We'll define the function solve(case):
    capacity = case['capacity']
    trials = case['trials']
    cache = {}  # signature -> {'last_trial': int, 'reflection': str, 'signature': str, 'success': bool}
    order = []  # list of signatures in order of last use (oldest first, newest last)
    for idx, trial in enumerate(trials):
        sig = trial['signature']
        if sig in cache:
            # update
            cache[sig] = {
                'last_trial': idx,
                'reflection': trial['reflection'],
                'signature': sig,
                'success': trial['success']
            }
            # move sig to end of order
            order.remove(sig)  # O(n) but small
            order.append(sig)
        else:
            # if at capacity, evict oldest
            if len(cache) >= capacity:
                oldest = order.pop(0)  # first element is oldest
                del cache[oldest]
            # add new
            cache[sig] = {
                'last_trial': idx,
                'reflection': trial['reflection'],
                'signature': sig,
                'success': trial['success']
            }
            order.append(sig)
    # After all trials, build memory in order of most recent first (reverse order)
    memory = [cache[sig] for sig in reversed(order)]
    signatures = [sig for sig in reversed(order)]
    return {
        'memory': memory,
        'signatures': signatures
    }

Note: order list maintains signatures in order of last use (oldest first, newest last). Reverse gives most recent first.
